metadata.title: # Allocate Treasury ETH for $POOH BuyBack and Burn (Q1 2026)
metadata.description:
# Allocate Treasury ETH for $POOH BuyBack and Burn (Q1 2026)
## Overview
This proposal allocates treasury ETH to buy back $POOH from the open market and burn it, reducing supply and supporting the floor price. As with our prior buyback and marketing proposals, the buys and burn will be executed manually in small blocks to avoid front-running. All buys and the burn are fully trackable on-chain; tx hashes will be posted in Discord. Execution wallet is specified in the proposal actions below.
## Details
- Buy $POOH across DEXs
- Burn acquired tokens to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD
- Community-aligned, long-term value creation for Pooh DAO

# Starting Marketing at Dextools + Dexscreener (Second Attempt)
## Overview:

This proposal aims to boost the growth of the POOH ecosystem through targeted advertising campaigns, utilizing the available funds of $50,000 to maximize visibility and engagement during the anticipated altcoin bullrun.

## Objective:

While social media posts on X (formerly known as Twitter) have fostered community engagement, they alone are insufficient for a significant uplift in market capitalization (MC). The objective is to drive upward momentum by directly reaching potential investors and traders through strategic advertising on specialized crypto platforms.

## Proposal Details

### Advertising Platforms:

#### **Dextools:**

* **Package:** Premium, approximately 1M views.
* **Duration:** Based on achieving approximately 1M views or impressions.
* **Cost:** $7,000.
* **Note:** The selected package will be tailored according to the allocated budget of $7,000.

![Dextools packages](https://static.tally.xyz/9033b756-108d-414a-adb9-b76f574f8778_original.png "Dextools packages")

#### **Dexscreener:**

* **Package:** Token Advertising.
* **Duration:** Based on achieving approximately 800K views or impressions.
* **Cost:** $7,000.

![Dexscreener package](https://static.tally.xyz/859572c0-e9ce-4ed8-a0d5-446f9151bcb1_original.png "Dexscreener package")

### Budget Allocation:

* **Total Initial Campaign Budget:** $14,000 (28% of the total $50,000 POOH funds).
  * **Dextools:** $7,000 (50% of the advertising budget).
  * **Dexscreener:** $7,000 (50% of the advertising budget).

### Wallet Address for Fund Allocation:

* **Wallet:** [0x52Cf9B141C55987Bb53375a9B72521d4D4AB1537](https://etherscan.io/address/0x52Cf9B141C55987Bb53375a9B72521d4D4AB1537 "0x52Cf9B141C55987Bb53375a9B72521d4D4AB1537")
* Funds allocated for the advertising budget will be sent in ETH to this wallet, which will handle payments for both Dextools and Dexscreener campaigns.
* **The funds will be converted from ETH to USDT to prevent depreciation in price.**
* The funds will be managed by the community member of Pooh: [https://t.me/leapooh](https://t.me/leapooh "@leapooh")
* **Note:** All transactions will be trackable on the Ethereum blockchain to ensure transparency.

### General Disclaimer:

* If the Dextools package cannot be purchased or if there are complications in the process, the next steps will depend on the performance of the Dexscreener advertising campaign:
  * If results (engagement, transaction volume) are positive, a second package on Dexscreener will be purchased.
  * If results are insufficient, the allocated funds (minus Ethereum gas fees) will be returned to the original wallet.
* If neither the Dextools nor the Dexscreener packages can be purchased, the entire $14,000 allocated for the campaign (minus Ethereum gas fees) will be returned to the original wallet.

### Campaign Goals:

* **Visibility:** Increase the recognition of $POOH among potential investors and traders.
* **Engagement:** Drive new wallet creations and boost trading volume.
* **Market Position:** Strengthen $POOH's presence in the altcoin market during the expected bullrun.

### Furniture for Advertising:

* **Dextools Advertising Panel:** Prominently displayed on the main dashboard, seen by users analyzing tokens.
* **Dexscreener Banner Placement:** A banner in the trending tokens section to catch the attention of active traders.

### Duration of Campaign:

* The initial advertising campaign will run until the desired impressions or views are achieved, with the potential for extension or adjustment based on performance.

## Expected Outcomes:

* Enhanced awareness of $POOH, potentially leading to a surge in interest and investment.
* Increased liquidity and trading volume due to broader exposure.
* A solid foundation for further marketing initiatives if this campaign proves successful.

## Risks and Contingency:

* **Volatility:** Crypto markets are volatile; the bullrun might be delayed or less pronounced than expected.
* **Platform Dependency:** Heavy reliance on Dextools and Dexscreener; any technical issue or policy change could affect campaign outcomes.

### Monitoring and Adjustment:

* Continuous monitoring of campaign performance through views, clicks, and trading volume.

## Summary:

This proposal allocates $14,000 from the $50,000 total funds for a strategic marketing effort on Dextools and Dexscreener. The campaign is designed to significantly increase visibility, trader engagement, and market strength for $POOH, leveraging the platforms where potential investors are actively looking for investment opportunities. This initial investment represents 28% of the available funds, aiming to kickstart growth with the possibility of scaling marketing efforts based on the campaign's success.

You can track the progress and updates of the project at the following link: [https://github.com/users/leapooh/projects/6](https://github.com/users/leapooh/projects/6)

metadata.title: DAO Proposal: Allocation of 2 ETH for TIGG and EEYOR Staking Rewards on Roll
metadata.description:
# DAO Proposal: Allocation of 2 ETH for TIGG and EEYOR Staking Rewards on Roll
## Proposal Summary

This proposal recommends the allocation of 2 ETH from the DAO treasury to purchase 1 ETH worth of TIGG and 1 ETH worth of EEYOR tokens. These tokens will be used as staking rewards on the [Roll platform](https://tryroll.com/), incentivizing users to lock ETH/TIGG or ETH/EEYOR pairs to earn yield.

$EEYOR : 0x07c904d8c04323ef9fe6bf13aaeba05b62c54825

$TIGG : 0x4f6AdC5f7427eBF43efe23347eB4eBAA398646Cf



## Proposal Details

### Objectives

1. **Increase Liquidity & Diversity of Ecosystem**: By holding TIGG and EEYOR, the DAO diversifies its asset portfolio.
2. **Enhance Staking Incentives**: Offering staking rewards will encourage users to participate in the staking program, thus increasing the use and value of both TIGG and EEYOR tokens.
3. **Boost Community Engagement**: Incentivizing staking helps in retaining users and growing the community.

### Plan

1. **Fund Allocation**: Allocate 2 ETH from the DAO treasury.
2. **Token Purchase**: Purchase 1 ETH worth of TIGG and 1 ETH worth of EEYOR tokens.
3. **Staking Rewards**: Distribute the purchased tokens as staking rewards on the Roll platform.
4. **Staking Requirements**: Users must lock ETH/TIGG or ETH/EEYOR pairs to earn yield.

### Implementation Steps

1. **Approval**: Obtain approval from DAO members for the allocation of 2 ETH.
2. **Execution**: Upon approval, execute the purchase of TIGG and EEYOR tokens using 2 ETH from the treasury.
3. **Integration**: Coordinate with Roll to set up the staking rewards program.
4. **Announcement**: Announce the staking program to the community, detailing the rewards and participation guidelines.

### Budget

* **Total Allocation**: 2 ETH
  * **TIGG Purchase**: 1 ETH
  * **EEYOR Purchase**: 1 ETH

### Timeline

* **Token Purchase**: Within 3 days of approval
* **Staking Program Launch**: Within 1 week of token purchase

### Expected Outcomes

1. **Increased Staking Participation**: A significant increase in the number of users participating in the staking program.
2. **Enhanced Token Utility**: Increased demand and trade volume for both TIGG and EEYOR tokens.
3. **Community Growth**: Greater engagement and growth of the DAO community.

### Voting

* **FOR**: Approve the allocation of 2 ETH from the treasury to purchase TIGG and EEYOR tokens for staking rewards.
* **AGAINST**: Reject the proposal and do not allocate 2 ETH from the treasury.

## Conclusion

This proposal aims to leverage the DAO's treasury to enhance staking rewards, increase asset diversity, and boost community engagement. By approving this proposal, the DAO will take a strategic step towards strengthening its position in the ecosystem and providing valuable incentives to its members.

metadata.title: Update to Pooh Voting Timelock Delay
metadata.description:
# Update to Pooh Voting Timelock Delay
**Purpose**

The purpose of this proposal is to decrease the time of the timelock delay. The timelock delay is a set amount of time for a delay before the proposal is executed. Currently the delay is set at 3 days. This proposal would be to set the timelock delay to 1 day. The value for the timelock delay is in seconds. The current delay is 259200 seconds. The value for the updated timelock delay would be 86400 seconds.

86400 seconds / 60 seconds per minutes / 60 minutes per hour / 24 hours per day = 1 day

metadata.title: Update to Pooh Proposal Voting Quorum
metadata.description:
# Update to Pooh Proposal Voting Quorum
**Purpose**

The purpose of this proposal is to decrease the quorum needed for votes to pass. With our current number of voters, proposals are very narrowly getting the votes needed to pass. This proposal will decrease the quorum size from 4% of total supply to 2% of total supply. The current quorum size is 16.82 trillion. The updated quorum size would be 8.41 trillion. This number can be updated in future proposals as the community grows.

metadata.title: Update to Pooh Voting Period
metadata.description:
# Update to Pooh Voting Period
**Purpose**

The purpose of this proposal is to decrease the voting period for Pooh proposals. The current voting period is set at 7 days and this proposal is set to decrease it to 3 days. The code requires the time period to be in number of blocks with the average block time being 12 seconds. The current value for voting period is 50400. Decreasing this number to 21600 will change the value to 3 days as:

(21600 blocks\*12 seconds per block)/60 seconds/60 minutes/24 hours = 3 Days.

metadata.title: Role Assignment
metadata.description:
# Role Assignment
**Purpose**

The purpose of this proposal is to assign roles nessecary to execute proposals from the Pooh DAO. This proposal would grant the role of "executor" as well as "canceller", "proposer", and "timelock admin". For the purposes of learning, this proposal will grant these roles to raisingthesteaks.eth to ensure this is the proper thing needed to execute any proposals. After this has been verified, roles can be granted to other members of the community through other proposals. These roles have no control over treasury funds and are strictly for proposal functions.
